import json
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace\review-tools')
from common import WS, freeze_json, frozen, require, sha, write_frozen
here = WS / 'scratch-126' / 'review'
derivation = json.loads(frozen(here / 'tooling-derivation.json', '9c969bd3206ca914be43962bc2454032f7e74f64238a8b872b31cb9d3f1b1bbd'))
for entry in derivation['derivations']:
    source = Path(entry['source']).read_bytes()
    require(sha(source) == entry['sourceSha256'], 'Protocol source changed')
    target = frozen(entry['target'], entry['targetSha256'])
    reverse = target.decode('utf-8')
    for replacement in reversed(entry['substitutions']):
        require(reverse.count(replacement['after']) == replacement['count'], 'Reverse count differs')
        reverse = reverse.replace(replacement['after'], replacement['before'])
    require(reverse.encode('utf-8') == source, 'Protocol reverse proof failed')
executions = {}
for folder, count, digest in (
    ('test-protocol-002', 78, '27dccd719d3f6805972ab118c10c8f113e12024bbbeedab362bc36b9a3456327'),
    ('test-candidate-tools-001', 11, '13e66297013cd7dbdde1d5abe8e7d45679517c37f7ab19f2d1fa7e877c71d514'),
):
    log = (here / folder / 'output.log').read_bytes()
    raw = (here / folder / 'receipt.json').read_bytes()
    result = json.loads(raw)
    require(sha(log) == digest == result['logSha256'] and result['exitCode'] == 0
            and result['childExitCodeAfterCleanup'] == 0 and not result['memory']['breach']
            and f'Ran {count} tests'.encode() in log and b'\nOK\n' in log.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'),
            'Test execution does not establish success')
    executions[folder] = {'tests': count, 'logSha256': digest, 'receiptSha256': sha(raw)}
files = {}
for name in ('verify_b126_sources.py', 'test_verify_b126_sources.py', 'prepare_b126_candidate.py', 'test_prepare_b126_candidate.py'):
    path = WS / 'review-tools' / name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    compile(raw, str(path), 'exec')
    path.chmod(stat.S_IREAD)
    require(frozen(path, sha(raw)) == raw, 'Frozen tool changed')
    files[name] = {'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'bytes': len(raw)}
issue_raw = Path(r'C:\Users\stop-\AppData\Local\Temp\1794792205332-copilot-tool-output-13980-f718c375-2bd6-4867-9bbb-1b0702d20617.txt').read_bytes()
issue = json.loads(issue_raw)
require(issue['number'] == 60 and issue['state'] == 'OPEN', 'Wrong governing issue')
issue_capture = write_frozen(here / 'issue60-at-tool-preparation.json', issue_raw)
print(json.dumps(freeze_json(here / 'coordinator-tooling-readiness-001.json', {
    'batch': 126, 'status': 'TOOLS_READY_CANDIDATE_NOT_ACCEPTED', 'base': 'ea9e1e364da4f3421a05d2a9706e5dcf44f0d797',
    'files': files, 'protocolDerivationSha256': sha((here / 'tooling-derivation.json').read_bytes()),
    'executions': executions, 'governingIssue': issue_capture,
    'scope': 'Frozen tested coordinator tooling only. No signed candidate proof, review packet, reviewer admission or content acceptance produced. Re-read the author handoff before running candidate tools.',
    'preservedFailure': {'directory': str(here / 'test-protocol-001'), 'reason': 'Unittest discovery skips hyphenated module names; explicit importlib loading recovered without changing fixtures.'},
})))
